evidence.title: Towards Actionable Surgical Team Dynamics: from Teamwork to Counterfactual Annotations
From Multimodal Observation to Interpretable Suggestions: Counterfactual Time-Expanded Relational Modeling of Surgical Teams

summary: Researchers developed an AI system that analyzes surgical team interactions and provides interpretable, actionable suggestions by modeling counterfactual scenarios. The approach leverages multimodal data to enhance teamwork and decision-making in operating rooms.
title: AI Model Uses Counterfactual Analysis to Improve Surgical Team Dynamics
